== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The later slip permits the once-per-turn search for an admiral or a card which mentions Executor in game text. The original lists Tactical Recall and Field Promotion separately. The later wording cancels Counter Assault, where the original bars its play. The Star Destroyer deployment, battle destiny and Landing Claw timing remain.
